changes: Implemented the deduped playbook seed promotion loop: source-lineage backed playbook_seed_observe, digest-guarded playbook_seed_propose_batch and playbook_candidate_batch_approve, explicit outcome/promotion safety rules, runtime consumption verification, playbook_promotion_status readiness fields, disabled-by-default playbook_auto_promotion_apply guard, and updated execution-plan docs for non_promotable terminology and V1/V2 boundaries.
usage: Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js playbook_seed_observe --json to inspect deduped historical learning seeds, playbook_seed_propose_batch --dryRun --limit=3 --json to preview proposal manifests, playbook_candidate_batch_approve --dryRun --json to preview candidate approval, playbook_runtime_consumption_verify --json to verify active/candidate runtime posture, and playbook_auto_promotion_apply --json to inspect the disabled V2 guard.
expectedOutcome: Users should see lineage-bound, digest-bound, non-authoritative playbook seed and proposal diagnostics. Dry-run commands should not write proposals/candidates/active playbooks; apply paths require reviewed digests; candidate material must stay out of runtime active guidance; V2 auto-promotion remains disabled unless future explicit prerequisites are satisfied.
actualTranscript: Real-machine checks observed playbook_seed_observe returning observeDigest 5295b9e0b3ea79149bde7d153cd7fc7e59edcd7c34740b195875525225216025 with authority non_authoritative and gateEvidence false; live_smoke_transcript captured playbook_seed_propose_batch --dryRun --limit=3 returning applied false, proposalCount 3, and proposalManifestDigest 36df665fd29332ed016d4bb597468f6a7f042b8889298f002533ce9e11074981; runtime verify returned non-authoritative warn no_active_playbooks_to_verify as expected; DONE-required validation passed build and npm test.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch. The implementation delivered the V1 seed/proposal/recommendation/runtime verification closure and intentionally did not auto-activate playbooks.
limitations: Intentional limitation: V2 automatic advisory activation is not enabled by this story; playbook_auto_promotion_apply remains a disabled-by-default guarded surface pending real outcome records and reviewed policy.
pitfalls: Major time sinks were Lattice lifecycle overhead rather than feature coding: repeated metadata commits caused stale evidence refreshes, done_prepare hit its 300s quiet watchdog after long validate output, and delivery-context evidence required a TEST to DEV rollback for scope acknowledgement before re-entering REVIEW and TEST. Future stories should avoid adding closure evidence after TEST scope is frozen, or have delivery_context_pack registered as lifecycle evidence.
